name: validate_cloudformation_template
description: Validate a CloudFormation template's syntax, AWS resource types, and property schemas using cfn-lint (offline; read-only). Use this to confirm a proposed architecture node maps to a real AWS resource type with valid properties before proposing a change, and to validate generated CloudFormation templates before deployment. Returns is_valid plus error/warning/info counts and per-issue line numbers and paths.

template_content.description: CloudFormation template as a YAML or JSON string.

regions.description: Optional AWS regions to validate against, e.g. ['us-east-1'].

ignore_checks.description: Optional cfn-lint rule IDs to ignore, e.g. ['W2001', 'E3012'].
